decisions.decision: Todo persists pending/in_progress/pending_acceptance/completed; Context persists created/in_progress/done and never owns Human acceptance.
Creation persists only a pending Todo. Scheduler scans pending Todos, creates/binds/runs Context, then advances the Todo to in_progress.
Scheduler scans in_progress Todos and uses Context runtime get_run(run_id); only COMPLETED advances Context to done and Todo to pending_acceptance.
FAILED, TIME_OUT, and ABORTED remain in_progress in the first version; no Todo failed state is introduced.
Acceptance is a Todo product state; approved completes Todo, rejected remains pending_acceptance, while Context remains done.
Manual Run remains only as a compensation/operations endpoint and is removed from the ordinary frontend flow.
No Todo/Context distributed transaction, persistent claim/lease columns, Todo editing, Context permission redesign, old Task changes, or team knowledge base work in this delivery.

findings.title: 拒绝验收后 Run 失败会留下不可恢复状态
findings.finding: 前端先调用 A 将 rejected Todo 原子改为 in_progress，再调用 B /run；若 /run 失败，A 不回滚，而当前 UI 对 in_progress 不提供重试、互动或再次验收入口，Todo 可能永久卡住。
evidence: apps/frontend-nextgen/src/hooks/useTodoDetail.ts

findings.required_action: 确认 /run 幂等和失败恢复契约：允许 in_progress 重试、调整调用顺序，或提供可靠异步补偿。
findings.resolution: Rejection now appends a B human_acceptance event and atomically moves A state to in_progress; B owns resume and no second Run is issued.

findings.title: B 的 Events 和 Run 路由在真实部署链路中不存在

apps/gateway/configs/application.yaml

findings.required_action: 确认由 Gateway 按 leaf path 分流、使用独立 B API client/base URL，或采用其他正式路由；同时冻结认证、Envelope、错误和幂等契约。
findings.resolution: Gateway now publishes /openapi/v1/todos routes and forwards them verbatim to backend; B is called server-side through TodoCollaborationPlugin.
